g.text: The two bracketings of `x * y * z` are DISTINCT terms; only one is reachable by parsing
so the second "*" cannot be absorbed
Display re-derives the brackets from the SAME table
left child inherits 2 -> 2 < 2 is false -> bare
right child inherits 3 -> 2 < 3 is true -> parenthesised
compares child 0 with child 0 and child 1 with child 1
Associativity is NOT realised here. It is realised
ONLY inside the Dovetail e-graph, and only for the
as the LEFT child of nothing
as the RIGHT child of a Mul
